title: Executing Knowledge Management in Support of Mission Command: A Primer for Senior Leaders

claims.label: Claim
claims.statement: Knowledge management connects people, processes, and tools so relevant knowledge reaches the decision maker in time.

claims.label: Interpretation
claims.statement: LLM missions must interconnect decisions, evidence, and current state so the next operator can continue without chat history.

reliability_notes: Official CALL primer with a clear publishing entity and accessible original text.
Use as operating-procedure evidence, not as primary doctrinal basis.
